prompt:
ONE original square premium painterly cinematic Mythics illustration of AMUNET, Egyptian primordial goddess and protector of the king.
ANATOMY: ONE adult female deity depicted in the documented goddess-with-RED-CROWN relief form, one human head, two eyes, exactly TWO arms; wear tall asymmetric Red Crown of Lower Egypt with high rear spike and a curled front wire, fully visible with a margin at top. Completely opaque heavy ivory linen gown and dark crimson mantle. [amunet-c01, amunet-c12]
MOMENT: Advance out from deep darkness to intercept the viewer at the threshold, thrust one open protective hand close to the lens, palm large in foreground, other arm sweeping her mantle outward; intense commanding gaze angled down toward viewer. Head and crown fill the upper half, guardian action fills the lower half.
POWER: No documented physical emission; darkness is ordinary low-key staging of her primordial/Hidden One associations, no dark energy emitted. Authority through crown and protective stance. [amunet-c04, amunet-c05, amunet-c08]
SCALE & CAMERA: extreme low angle, very tight chest-up crop with foreshortened large near hand; she occupies ninety percent of frame, no giant literal body or tiny scale humans.
LIGHT & WEATHER: one narrow hard amber shaft of light falls on the crown edge, severe eyes and near hand; the surrounding sanctuary falls into near-black shadow, ordinary dust visible in that shaft.
SURFACE: rough ivory woven linen, creased red cloth, weathered red crown, plain worn stone.
SETTING: Thebes sanctuary threshold, only blank UNCARVED jambs and plain stone visible; absolutely no inscriptions, carved hieroglyphs or patterned symbols. [amunet-c02, amunet-c12]
MOOD: awe-inspiring sacred guardian emerging from darkness, imposing and overwhelming, never cute, calm or decorative.
HARD CONSTRAINTS: no text, lettering, glyphs, inscriptions, logo, border, frame or watermark; no extra heads, limbs or fingers, wings or snakes; no design borrowed from any film, game, anime or comic; no nudity or explicit gore; no generic glow aura, neon outline or energy ribbons; no invented magical objects, staff or elemental effect.
